# Preparation predictors 2013

## 01. Parcel and location characteristics
Description: Calculation of parcel charcteristics (area_par, peri_par, shp_par, share_area_foot_par, access_par, ucp_par) and characteristics of the location where the parcel is located (heritage_single, heritage_ensemble, mun_prop, service_quality, center_quality, HP_euro_qm, AR_euro_qm, styp_simple, bplan, brw)

```{r, include=FALSE}
render("./code/data_preparation_2013/01_parcels_variables.Rmd")
```

## 02. Calculate largest non-built-up area
Description: Calculates largest non-built-up area of parcels. 

```{r, include=FALSE}
render("./code/data_preparation_2013/02_parcels_variables_long_calc.Rmd")
```

## 03. Land use and inhabitants
Description: Calculation of parcel variables (use_code_par, use_name_par, use_cat_par, id_block, avg_age, only_over_75_dummy)

```{r, include=FALSE}
render("./code/data_preparation_2013/03_parcels_link_back_merged.Rmd")
```

## 04. Add bldg variables
Description: We add building information to parcels.

```{r, include=FALSE}
render("./code/data_preparation_2013/04_add_building_infos.Rmd")
```

## 05. Add neighbour variables
Description: We add neighbourhood information to parcels.

```{r, include=FALSE}
render("./code/data_preparation_2013/05_add_neighbour_infos.Rmd")
```

## 06. Prepare final dataset with predictors
Description: Final dataset for modelling input is created. 

